critique: The artwork achieves a stunning cyber-aquatic fusion by seamlessly layering an algorithmic, canvas-drawn whale and drifting bioluminescent plankton behind crisp, neon-stroked SVG HUD panels. However, the inclusion of unresolvable external image files (`portrait.png` and `guineapig.png`) introduces broken visual placeholders that rudely shatter the otherwise deeply immersive, generative atmosphere.
